data.gender_notes: Borivoj is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Slavic elements boru 'war' and voj 'army' or 'military'. This name was borne by several early Christian rulers and saints, signifying a fearless and valiant warrior of God. The name Borivoj carries the meaning “Bold, Glorious Warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Borivoj usually hope their child will grow to embody bold, glorious warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Borivoj total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
